description: Indeterminate vine bearing small sweet fruits. Needs staking/cage and consistent moisture.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid every 2-4 weeks; switch to low-nitrogen high-phosphorus at flowering.
grooming_propagation: Remove suckers on indeterminate types; stake or cage. Propagate by seed or cuttings.
common_pests: Aphids, whiteflies, hornworms, blight, blossom end rot.
symptoms: Yellow lower leaves = nutrient deficiency or blight; black bottom = blossom end rot (calcium/water issue).
toxicity_notes: Fruit safe; leaves/stems contain tomatine (mildly toxic) - don't eat foliage.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 2 cups chopped; ≈ 3 lbs paste tomatoes per quart marinara (water_bath_canning, acidified with lemon juice/citric acid)
pinching_bolting_notes: Remove suckers on indeterminate vines; stake or cage early.

description: Large slicing tomato with meaty flesh. Indeterminate; needs sturdy support.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid every 2-4 weeks; low-nitrogen high-phosphorus at flowering.
grooming_propagation: Remove suckers; stake or cage heavily. Propagate by seed.
common_pests: Aphids, whiteflies, hornworms, blight, blossom end rot.
symptoms: Yellow lower leaves = blight or deficiency; cracking = irregular watering.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 2 cups chopped; ≈ 3 lbs tomatoes per quart marinara (water_bath_canning, acidified)
pinching_bolting_notes: Stake or cage heavily; prune suckers on indeterminate types.

description: Oval plum tomato with firm flesh; ideal for sauces and canning. Often determinate.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid every 2-4 weeks; low-nitrogen at flowering.
grooming_propagation: Cage or stake; minimal pruning on determinate types. Propagate by seed.
common_pests: Aphids, hornworms, blight, blossom end rot.
symptoms: Black bottom = blossom end rot; yellowing = blight or deficiency.
culinary_aliases: roma tomato, plum tomato, paste tomato
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 2.5 cups chopped; ≈ 2.5 lbs paste tomatoes per quart marinara (water_bath_canning, acidified with lemon juice)
pinching_bolting_notes: Determinate types need little pruning; stake or cage.

description: Sweet pepper with thick-walled blocky fruits. Slow to start; needs warmth.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid every 2-4 weeks; avoid excess nitrogen.
grooming_propagation: Stake if heavy fruit load. Propagate by seed.
common_pests: Aphids, flea beetles, blossom end rot.
symptoms: Yellow = overwater or deficiency; blossom drop = temperature stress.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 2 cups chopped; pressure_canning required unless pickled/acidified
pinching_bolting_notes: Stake if fruit-heavy; harvest green or wait for color.

description: Medium-heat chili pepper. Harvest green or red; prolific producer.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid every 2-4 weeks.
grooming_propagation: Stake if needed. Propagate by seed.
common_pests: Aphids, flea beetles, blossom end rot.
symptoms: Yellow = overwater; blossom drop = temperature stress.
toxicity_notes: Safe; capsaicin irritates skin/eyes - wear gloves when handling many.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 2 cups sliced; pressure_canning unless pickled/acidified
pinching_bolting_notes: Harvest green for mild or red for hotter; wear gloves.

description: Vining cucumber for fresh eating. Trellis to save space and keep fruit clean.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid every 2 weeks; heavy feeder.
grooming_propagation: Trellis vines; harvest frequently to encourage more fruit. Propagate by seed.
common_pests: Cucumber beetles, aphids, powdery mildew, squash bugs.
symptoms: Bitter fruit = heat/water stress; yellow leaves = mildew or overwater.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 2.5 cups sliced; water_bath_canning only when pickled/acidified (dill pickles)
pinching_bolting_notes: Trellis vines; harvest daily to keep producing.

description: Bushy summer squash; prolific producer. Harvest small for best flavor.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid every 2 weeks; heavy feeder.
grooming_propagation: Harvest frequently at 6-8 inches; remove diseased leaves. Propagate by seed.
common_pests: Squash vine borer, squash bugs, powdery mildew.
symptoms: Wilting = vine borer; powdery white leaves = mildew; blossom end rot = calcium.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 2.5 cups sliced; pressure_canning unless pickled/acidified
pinching_bolting_notes: Harvest small (6-8 in) frequently; oversize fruits reduce yield.

description: Cool-season leafy green with upright crisp heads. Bolt-resistant varieties available.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid every 2-4 weeks; avoid excess nitrogen near harvest.
grooming_propagation: Harvest outer leaves or whole head. Succession sow every 2-3 weeks.
symptoms: Bitter leaves = bolting from heat; yellow = overwater or nitrogen deficiency.
preservation_conversion: Fresh only; does not freeze, blanch, or can well.
pinching_bolting_notes: Succession sow every 2-3 weeks; shade in heat to delay bolting.

description: Cool-season leafy green; bolts quickly in heat and long days.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid every 3-4 weeks.
grooming_propagation: Harvest outer leaves; succession sow every 2-3 weeks in spring/fall.
symptoms: Yellow = overwater or nitrogen deficiency; bolting = heat/long days.
pinching_bolting_notes: Succession sow every 2-3 weeks; bolts in heat.

description: Hardy cool-season leafy green; flavor improves after frost.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid every 4-6 weeks.
grooming_propagation: Harvest outer leaves; cut-and-come-again. Propagate by seed.
common_pests: Cabbage worms, aphids, flea beetles, clubroot.
symptoms: Holes in leaves = cabbage worms; yellowing = overwater or deficiency.
pinching_bolting_notes: Harvest outer leaves continuously; flavor sweetens after frost.

description: Cool-season root vegetable. Needs loose, rock-free soil for straight roots.
fertilizing: Low-nitrogen fertilizer at planting; too much nitrogen forks roots.
grooming_propagation: Direct sow only; thin seedlings to 2-3 inches. Propagate by seed.
common_pests: Carrot rust fly, nematodes, leaf blight.
symptoms: Forked/stunted roots = rocky soil or excess nitrogen; yellow leaves = blight.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 3 cups sliced; pressure_canning required unless pickled
pinching_bolting_notes: Direct sow only; thin seedlings. Do not transplant.

description: Fast-growing cool-season root; ready in 3-4 weeks. Succession sow for continuous harvest.
fertilizing: Light feeding; too much nitrogen grows leaves not roots.
grooming_propagation: Direct sow; thin to 2 inches. Succession sow every 1-2 weeks.
symptoms: Pithy/hot roots = too much heat or slow growth; cracked = irregular water.
pinching_bolting_notes: Succession sow every 1-2 weeks; harvest young before pithy.

description: Cool-season brassica with edible flower heads. Harvest before florets open.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid every 3-4 weeks; heavy feeder.
grooming_propagation: Harvest main head; side shoots continue. Propagate by seed.
common_pests: Cabbage worms, aphids, flea beetles, clubroot.
symptoms: Loose head = heat stress; yellow = overwater or deficiency.
pinching_bolting_notes: Harvest head before flowers open; side shoots extend harvest.

description: Cool-season brassica with edible curd. Blanch heads to keep white.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid every 3-4 weeks; heavy feeder.
grooming_propagation: Tie leaves over head to blanch. Propagate by seed.
symptoms: Buttoning (small head) = stress; yellow = overwater.
pinching_bolting_notes: Blanch heads by tying leaves over; sensitive to temperature swings.

description: Bush snap bean; no trellis needed. Heavy producer over short window.
fertilizing: Light feeding; fixes its own nitrogen.
grooming_propagation: Harvest pods frequently; succession sow every 2-3 weeks. Propagate by seed.
symptoms: Yellow = overwater; poor set = temperature stress.
toxicity_notes: Safe; raw beans contain lectins - cook before eating.
culinary_aliases: bush bean, green bean, snap bean
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 4 cups trimmed; pressure_canning required unless pickled
pinching_bolting_notes: Harvest pods frequently; succession sow every 2-3 weeks.

description: Climbing snap bean; needs trellis. Longer harvest window than bush types.
fertilizing: Light feeding; fixes its own nitrogen.
grooming_propagation: Trellis required; harvest pods frequently. Propagate by seed.
symptoms: Yellow = overwater; poor set = temperature stress.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 4 cups trimmed; pressure_canning required unless pickled
pinching_bolting_notes: Trellis required; harvest pods frequently for continuous production.

description: Cool-season climbing pea with edible pods. Trellis and harvest young.
fertilizing: Light feeding; fixes nitrogen.
grooming_propagation: Trellis vines; harvest pods daily. Propagate by seed.
symptoms: Yellow = overwater; poor pod set = heat.
culinary_aliases: snap pea, sugar snap pea, edible pod pea
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 4 cups pods; pressure_canning required unless pickled
pinching_bolting_notes: Trellis vines; harvest pods daily; cool-season only.

description: Cool-season tuber crop. Hill soil around stems as plants grow.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid every 4-6 weeks; avoid excess nitrogen.
grooming_propagation: Hill soil around stems; harvest after foliage dies. Propagate by seed potatoes.
common_pests: Colorado potato beetle, aphids, blight, scab.
symptoms: Green tubers = sun exposure (toxic); black spots = blight.
toxicity_notes: Tubers safe; green parts and green potatoes contain solanine (toxic).
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 3 cups cubed; pressure_canning required unless pickled
pinching_bolting_notes: Hill soil around stems as plants grow; harvest after foliage dies back.

description: Cool-season bulb crop. Day-length sensitive; choose short/long-day variety for your zone.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid every 3-4 weeks; stop when bulbs form.
grooming_propagation: Harvest when tops fall over; cure in dry airy place. Propagate by sets/seeds.
symptoms: Yellow = overwater; soft bulbs = rot.
toxicity_notes: Safe for humans; toxic to dogs/cats in quantity.
pinching_bolting_notes: Harvest when tops fall over; cure before storage.

description: Fall-planted bulb crop; harvest mid-summer. Hardneck or softneck varieties.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid in early spring; stop when bulbs swell.
grooming_propagation: Plant cloves in fall; harvest when lower leaves brown. Cure before storage.
symptoms: Yellow = overwater; small bulbs = nutrient lack or crowding.
toxicity_notes: Safe for humans; toxic to dogs/cats in quantity.
pinching_bolting_notes: Plant cloves in fall; harvest mid-summer when lower leaves brown.

description: Cool-season root with edible roots and greens. Thin seedlings carefully.

grooming_propagation: Direct sow; thin to 3 inches. Harvest roots at 1-3 inches. Propagate by seed.
symptoms: Small roots = crowding or nutrient lack; yellow = overwater.
preservation_conversion: 1 lb fresh ≈ 2 cups sliced; pressure_canning required unless pickled
pinching_bolting_notes: Direct sow; thin seedlings; harvest roots young.

description: Heat-tolerant leafy green with colorful stems. Cut-and-come-again all season.

pinching_bolting_notes: Harvest pods daily young (2-4 in); pods toughen quickly.

description: Warm-season grain/vegetable; plant in blocks for pollination. Harvest at milk stage.

pinching_bolting_notes: Plant in blocks for pollination; harvest at milk stage.

pinching_bolting_notes: Harvest after frost for best sweetness; long season crop.

description: Cool-season root; sweetens after frost. Slow to germinate.

description: Cool-season brassica with edible swollen stem. Fast-growing.

description: Cool-season bitter green; frilly leaves for salads.

description: Cool-season Asian green with crisp white stems and dark leaves. Fast-growing.

pinching_bolting_notes: Succession sow every 2 weeks; bolts in heat.

description: Cool-season green with spicy, peppery leaves. Fast-growing.

grooming_propagation: Harvest leaves continuously; succession sow every 2 weeks.

pinching_bolting_notes: Cut-and-come-again; succession sow every 2 weeks.

grooming_propagation: Harvest outer leaves continuously. Propagate by seed.

pinching_bolting_notes: Harvest outer leaves continuously; heat-tolerant brassica.

description: Fractal-patterned broccoli-cauliflower hybrid with nutty flavor.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid every 3-4 weeks; heavy feeder.
grooming_propagation: Harvest head when tight. Propagate by seed.
symptoms: Loose head = stress; yellow = overwater.
pinching_bolting_notes: Harvest head when tight and green.

description: Perennial with edible tart stalks. Leaves are toxic (oxalic acid) - never eat.
fertilizing: Balanced liquid every 6-8 weeks in growing season.
grooming_propagation: Harvest stalks only; remove flower stalks. Divide every 5-10 years. Propagate by division.
symptoms: Yellow = overwater; thin stalks = nutrient lack or crowding.
toxicity_notes: STALKS ONLY - leaves contain oxalic acid and are toxic. Never eat leaves.
pinching_bolting_notes: Harvest stalks only; NEVER eat leaves (toxic oxalic acid).

description: Perennial spring vegetable; establishes slowly, produces for decades.

symptoms: Thin spears = young plant or nutrient lack; rust spots = fungal disease.
toxicity_notes: Spears safe; berries toxic if eaten.
pinching_bolting_notes: Harvest spears spring only; let ferns grow to feed roots.

description: Perennial thistle relative with edible flower buds. Mild climate preferred.

grooming_propagation: Harvest buds before opening; cut back after fruiting. Propagate by offsets/division.
symptoms: Small buds = nutrient lack; yellow = overwater.
pinching_bolting_notes: Harvest buds before flowers open; perennial in mild zones.
